title: Harvington Singers Christmas Concert: Sing a Song of Gladness! — St James' Church, Harvington
body: The Harvington Singers' Christmas concert at 7.30pm (also on Saturday 5 December at 2.30pm). Tickets £9 for adults, £5 for children, online, by email (tickets@harvingtonsingers.org.uk) or by phone (07377 932557).

image.alt: Poster for the Harvington Singers Christmas Concert, Sing a Song of Gladness!: Friday 4 December 7.30pm and Saturday 5 December 2.30pm at St James' Church, Harvington, with five carol singers in winter coats and scarves in the snow
